title: GTA6 Online Mode Predicted to Launch Next Year by Twitch CEO
description: Rockstar has not yet commented on a GTA 6 Online multiplayer mode, but Twitch's CEO predicts it will arrive next year. The game launches with only the single-player campaign.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Twitch CEO Predicts GTA6 Online Arrival Next Year Amid Rockstar's Silence

As the release date for *Grand Theft Auto VI* approaches, the gaming community is filled with anticipation regarding its future components. According to reports from Eurogamer, Rockstar Games has remained tight-lipped about the potential successor to *GTA 5*'s immensely popular *Grand Theft Auto Online*, avoiding any official comments on whether a multiplayer mode will even launch.

All concrete information currently confirmed indicates that when *Grand Theft Auto 6* arrives on **November 19**, it will launch strictly with the single-player campaign. 

Despite the lack of official details from the developers, external industry figures are weighing in. Notably, Twitch's CEO has chimed in, expressing a prediction that the anticipated multiplayer component will likely land next year. 

### What Lies Ahead for GTA6 Multiplayer?

Given the monumental, decade-long success of *GTA Online*, the stakes are exceptionally high for the next iteration. While Rockstar has chosen to keep its cards close to its chest regarding the online ecosystem, speculations like the one from Twitch's CEO highlight just how much the industry is watching for the inevitable multiplayer rollout. For now, players must look forward to the November 19 single-player launch while keeping an eye out for future official announcements from Rockstar.

## Editor's Take

While the prediction from Twitch's CEO offers an interesting timeline to consider, it remains pure speculation until Rockstar Games makes an official statement. Rockstar has always prioritized delivering a polished single-player experience first, and keeping quiet about online features allows them to control the narrative. Patience will be key for fans eager to step into the next generation of online crime.
